implementation: KeywordReader::MatrixRowRead and matrix_row(), replay protocol matrix4

contract.destinations: One signed32 label and four binary64 values, all initialized to zero before fgets.
contract.line: One fgets at capacity1024; commas before first NUL become spaces. No blank-line retry.
contract.scan: Legacy %i %Flf %Flf %Flf %Flf; preserve successful partial assignments and zero remaining destinations.
contract.status: 1 for fgets-null or scan-count -1; 0 for all other scan counts including zero.
contract.stream: Consumes the entire bounded line independently of the number of successful conversions.
contract.matrix_commit: Caller399e60 uses four rows in a temporary16-value matrix and commits only after all row statuses0. Earlier clear/empty-segment creation is not rolled back on row failure.

limitations: Reader destinations are independent; aliased discarded-prefix outputs belong to coordinates3, not matrix_row.
Legacy decimal lexer and bounded finite numeric domain are shared with previously recovered readers. Overflow, nonfinite numbers, embedded NUL and changing locale remain outside compatibility claim.
Static pseudocode is recovered binary evidence, not original source.
